data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing .SRCINFO, resulting in an 'inconclusive' file verdict that dragged the overall package verdict to 'inconclusive'. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the executable packaging files (PKGBUILD) are verified safe.
